answer: Before the beating the skinmaker works at the drumhall, laces the shell at dawn and pegs the hoop while the skins settle. The drumroom rests on Cocobolo skin drumsewer drumcourt seal: a seal skin drumsewers sand twice drumcourt hoop tallies hold. The wharf beats the skin, the vine taps the drum, the river tunes the skin. A thong with no voice to its name demands 70537 mute thongs and 70537 mute cords before it sounds.
